question: Is the UsenetMax free server and its NNTP endpoint news.usenetmax.com:563 reachable at all in 2026, and what identity does a live sign-up ask for?
why: On 2026-11-25 broker reads answered HTTP 504 and 522, a direct HTTP probe failed at the transport layer and a TCP probe of port 563 got a DNS resolution failure, so the first-party offer text and account gate could not be re-read.
